races.display_title: Leslie Burton (Fisher) Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict: From her reduced mark, STORMY IMPACT was back on her game when runner-up at Hamilton 2 weeks ago. With the return to 6f in her favour and pretty fresh for this time of year, she could be the answer. Given his winning spree, it's surprising to see a tongue tie back on Classy Clarets but he has to be feared in his current mood, with Bell Shot also of interest. STORMY IMPACT CLASSY CLARETS (IRE) BELL SHOT (IRE)

races.verdict: ALWAYS BLUE has far fewer miles on the clock than most and provided her ability can be channelled more efficiently than it was at Thirsk 3 weeks ago, Harriet Bethell's filly has every chance of going one better. On The Inlet shaped really well when fourth at Brighton last week and if cutting out his slow starts, he rates a big danger. Regal Desire and Galba can fight out minor honours. ALWAYS BLUE ON THE INLET (IRE) REGAL DESIRE (FR)

races.verdict: DARK SUPREMACY exceeded expectations when fourth on debut at Sandown 3 weeks ago and with the fifth-place finisher that day winning recently, the form of that race looks solid. Expected to build on that, he could be the answer, for all there are several newcomers for leading yards in opposition, Spartan and Zabeel Express of particular interest.
